updates.title: Documentation, and a change in approach
updates.summary: Before any code was written, we wrote up the project proposal, scope, roadmap and a research plan — then decided to change how we'd actually work.
completed: Wrote the project proposal: overview, context, stakeholders, and the initial areas to investigate.
Drafted the project roadmap and revised its effort/duration estimate (2 students, 5 hours/week each, 16 weeks).
Wrote a research plan for Weeks 3–6 covering who we'd talk to, what we wanted to learn, and when.
updates.approachChange: The original roadmap laid out fixed phases — research, then define and design, then a single test-and-improve phase near the end. We decided against that: instead we're working in short cycles, building a prototype, showing it to real users, gathering feedback, improving it, and repeating. Research and user conversations now happen alongside each cycle instead of as one separate phase.
nextSteps: Start the first build-show-learn cycle instead of the original Week 3–6 research phase.

updates.title: First prototype: a working directory of projects, batches, and roles
updates.summary: Following the change in approach above, this is the first build-show-learn cycle: a working prototype of the project directory, rather than more up-front research.
completed: Designed the data model and screens for a project directory, grouped into batches, with role-based permissions for students, mentors and the coordinator.
added: Project directory home page: browse as cards or a table, search by title, and filter by batch, domain, status, or "only mine".
Batches: list view, a side-panel to create a new batch, and a batch detail page grouping its projects.
Add Project flow (side panel) and full project form: title, description, domain, team members, mentor, problem, outcome, and material links.
Role switcher (student / mentor / coordinator) that demonstrates what each role can see and do, ahead of real sign-in.
Duplicate-title detection that flags likely repeat project titles before saving.
This Project progress page and a sidebar collaborators panel.
improved: When a mentor creates a project, the Mentor field is now pre-filled with their own name and locked, since a mentor always mentors the projects they add.
Add Project and Add Batch panels keep Cancel/Save pinned in a fixed footer instead of scrolling away with the form.
The top header bar is now sticky so it stays visible while a page scrolls.
The sidebar's selected item now shows solid white in light mode for clearer contrast; dark mode is unchanged.
removed: The cover-image / placeholder graphic on project cards in the directory — cards now lead with status, title, team, and mentor.
unfinished: Not shown to real users yet — no testing or feedback has been recorded for this prototype.
nextSteps: Show this prototype to students, mentors and/or the coordinator and record what we learn.
No persistence yet — data resets on refresh; a real backend/database is next.
No real authentication yet; the role switcher stands in for sign-in.
"Materials" are pasted links today, not uploaded files.
